what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Poland, as recorded by IDMC.
IDMC's year-end count of people still displaced by disasters went from 22 in 2020 to 121 in 2021.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Poland list floods.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for Poland in these years.

when.text: The main year of displacement in the data is 2021.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 20 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Poland.
